name: Vertiv - 800 VDC: the next evolution of AI power architecture (vendor learning-center resource index entry)
notes: Vendor thermal-management landing page that indexes Vertiv's own high-density cooling and power portfolio, and confirms the industry has begun publishing an 800 VDC distribution architecture as the successor to the 54V rack busbar that dominates today's racks. Low confidence on specifics: the page is a portfolio index, and the numeric claims sit behind gated/downloadable assets that were not retrievable at capture time. Cited only for the existence and naming of the 800 VDC transition and Vertiv's high-density cooling product line, NOT for any watt, kW or density figure. Also surfaced a related 2024 Vertiv-NVIDIA AI factory power/thermal press release URL that now 404s - the correct path is /news-and-events/ rather than /news-and-insights/.
